articles.title: Security cabinet discusses renewing Gaza war as Hamas refuses to disarm
articles.description: Israeli security cabinet scheduled to discuss renewing the war in Gaza as negotiations to disarm Hamas and demilitarize the Strip stall. Israeli official states Hamas is not standing by the agreement on disarmament.

articles.title: IDF reports 19 Gaza ceasefire violations between April 21 and May 5
articles.description: Israeli military reports 19 ceasefire violations including eliminations of armed Palestinian Islamic Jihad members and Hamas militants operating in Gaza. Operations conducted across northern, central, and southern Gaza.

articles.title: Netanyahu meets Board of Peace representative on Gaza negotiations
articles.description: Prime Minister Netanyahu meets with Board of Peace pointman Nickolay Mladenov and US Ambassador Mike Huckabee on May 5 to discuss implementation of Trump's 20-Point Comprehensive Plan for Gaza.

articles.title: Israel threatens to resume Gaza fighting if Hamas continues refusing disarmament
articles.description: Israeli military official states additional round of fighting is 'almost inevitable' due to Hamas refusal to surrender weapons. IDF continues expanding territorial control beyond ceasefire limits.

articles.title: IDF claims elimination of Hamas military intelligence head
articles.description: On April 28, IDF reports elimination of Ahmed Abd al Rahman Shambari, head of operations in Hamas's military intelligence headquarters. Part of ongoing ceasefire violation responses.

articles.title: Hamas rejects disarmament demands as continuation of genocide
articles.description: Hamas armed wing spokesman Abu Obeida states that disarmament demands amount to an attempt to continue Israel's genocide. Hamas political bureau member demands IDF withdraw from Yellow Line before negotiations.

articles.title: Hamas political bureau member Bassem Naim reports Israeli territorial expansion
articles.description: Senior Hamas official Bassem Naim states Israel has shifted an additional 8-9% of territory beyond ceasefire boundaries, increasing Israeli control to over 62% of Gaza and leaving Palestinians with roughly 38%.

articles.title: Palestinian factions united in rejecting disarmament prerequisite
articles.description: Hamas, Palestinian Islamic Jihad and Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine form unified front rejecting disarmament demands. Groups insist on full implementation of ceasefire's first phase instead.

articles.title: Hamas demands IDF withdrawal before disarmament negotiations
articles.description: Hamas repeatedly demands Israel Defense Forces pull back from the Yellow Line dividing Hamas and Israeli-controlled territory in Gaza before any disarmament negotiations can proceed.

articles.title: Hamas disputes Israel's humanitarian aid claims and ceasefire compliance
articles.description: Hamas counters Israeli narrative on disarmament, accusing Israel of blocking agreed-upon entry of 600 aid trucks daily and violating first phase commitments. Hamas submits counter-offer linking weapons to Palestinian statehood.
